say:1:1322434001:1.text: Thanks to your lead, we've managed to figure out their schedule.
say:1:1322434001:1.source_cn: 按照您提供的线索，我们的人已经摸索出了他们举行礼拜的时...
say:1:1322434001:1.male: Thanks to your lead, we've managed to figure out their schedule.
say:1:1322434001:1.female: Thanks to your lead, we've managed to figure out their schedule.

say:2:1322434002:1.text: By our calculations, their next gathering will happen tonight.
say:2:1322434002:1.source_cn: 不出意外的话，这一轮礼拜就在今天。
say:2:1322434002:1.male: By our calculations, their next gathering will happen tonight.
say:2:1322434002:1.female: By our calculations, their next gathering will happen tonight.

say:3:1322434003:1.text: The guards are spread too thin, and this mission is not one we can afford to bungle. Right now, there's only one person I trust to get it done. And that's you.
say:3:1322434003:1.source_cn: 现在卫队人手不足，而且这项任务又很艰巨，恐怕适合人选只...
say:3:1322434003:1.male: The guards are spread too thin, and this mission is not one we can afford to bungle. Right now, there's only one person I trust to get it done. And that's you.
say:3:1322434003:1.female: The guards are spread too thin, and this mission is not one we can afford to bungle. Right now, there's only one person I trust to get it done. And that's you.

choice_prompt:4:1322434003.text: The guards are spread too thin, and this mission is not one we can afford to bungle. Right now, there's only one person I trust to get it done. And that's you.
choice_prompt:4:1322434003.source_cn: 现在卫队人手不足，而且这项任务又很艰巨，恐怕适合人选只有您了。
choice_prompt:4:1322434003.male: The guards are spread too thin, and this mission is not one we can afford to bungle. Right now, there's only one person I trust to get it done. And that's you.
choice_prompt:4:1322434003.female: The guards are spread too thin, and this mission is not one we can afford to bungle. Right now, there's only one person I trust to get it done. And that's you.

say:5:1322434010:1.text: Well, Magister, there's no time to waste. You must leave at once.
say:5:1322434010:1.source_cn: 那么魔法师大人，刻不容缓，请您尽快出发吧。
say:5:1322434010:1.male: Well, Magister, there's no time to waste. You must leave at once.
say:5:1322434010:1.female: Well, Magister, there's no time to waste. You must leave at once.

say:6:1322434011:1.text: And... please, be careful. I don't want to see my friends getting hurt over this.
say:6:1322434011:1.source_cn: 还有，请你们一定注意安全，我不希望朋友在这次调查中受伤……

say:8:1322434004:1.text: O-Of course! I'd never underpay you.
say:8:1322434004:1.source_cn: 当、那是当然，您的费用我从来都没有轻视过。
say:8:1322434004:1.male: O-Of course! I'd never underpay you.
say:8:1322434004:1.female: O-Of course! I'd never underpay you.

say:10:1322434005:1.text: Haha... relax, <style="stress"><player_name></style> was just messing with you.
say:10:1322434005:1.male: Haha... relax, <style="stress"><player_name></style> was just messing with you.
say:10:1322434005:1.female: Haha... relax, <style="stress"><player_name></style> was just messing with you.

say:12:1322434007:1.text: Don't get all worked up, Rodrigo. <style="stress"><player_name></style> just thinks you need to loosen up a bit.
say:12:1322434007:1.male: Don't get all worked up, Rodrigo. <style="stress"><player_name></style> just thinks you need to loosen up a bit.
say:12:1322434007:1.female: Don't get all worked up, Rodrigo. <style="stress"><player_name></style> just thinks you need to loosen up a bit.

say:13:1322434008:1.text: Thanks, I appreciate it... Just reminded me of how Princess Yolena used to joke around with me too...
say:13:1322434008:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们的好意……我只是忽然想起亚莲娜公主也总会跟我开...

say:14:1322434009:1.text: Never mind. This isn't the time for reminiscing.
say:14:1322434009:1.source_cn: 没什么，只是一瞬间想到了这些，我清楚现在不是时候。

say:1:1322435001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if we want to investigate their gathering, it's best to go in disguised as cultists.
say:1:1322435001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if we want to investigate their gathering, it's best to go in disguised as cultists.
say:1:1322435001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if we want to investigate their gathering, it's best to go in disguised as cultists.

say:2:1322435002:1.text: To avoid drawing attention, I suggest we <style="stress">split up</style>.
say:2:1322435002:1.source_cn: 为了掩人耳目，我建议咱们<style=stress>分...

say:3:1322435003:1.text: Oh! Then I'll go with Magister.
say:3:1322435003:1.male: Oh! Then I'll go with Magister.
say:3:1322435003:1.female: Oh! Then I'll go with Magister.

say:4:1322435004:1.text:
No, Chippy.
You and I stand out too much. The two of us will stay outside and keep watch.
say:4:1322435004:1.source_cn: 不，满满。\n就是因为你和我比较显眼所以才要掩人耳目，...

say:1:1322438001:0.text: Hey, you there! New face! Stop right there! First time at the gathering?
say:1:1322438001:0.source_cn: 喂，那边的新面孔，站住站住！第一次来礼拜吗？
say:1:1322438001:0.male: Hey, you there! New face! Stop right there! First time at the gathering?
say:1:1322438001:0.female: Hey, you there! New face! Stop right there! First time at the gathering?

choice_prompt:2:1322438001.text: Hey, you there! New face! Stop right there! First time at the gathering?
choice_prompt:2:1322438001.source_cn: 喂，那边的新面孔，站住站住！第一次来礼拜吗？
choice_prompt:2:1322438001.male: Hey, you there! New face! Stop right there! First time at the gathering?
choice_prompt:2:1322438001.female: Hey, you there! New face! Stop right there! First time at the gathering?

say:3:1322438002:1.text: Not talking? Doesn't matter. I've still got questions for you. Rules are rules.
say:3:1322438002:1.source_cn: 不吭声？按照规矩，该问的问题都得问，不吭声也得问，听好了……
say:3:1322438002:1.male: Not talking? Doesn't matter. I've still got questions for you. Rules are rules.
say:3:1322438002:1.female: Not talking? Doesn't matter. I've still got questions for you. Rules are rules.

say:4:1322438004:1.text: Tell me, what does the Great Will mean to you?
say:4:1322438004:1.source_cn: 说说看，伟大意志在你心中是什么？
say:4:1322438004:1.male: Tell me, what does the Great Will mean to you?
say:4:1322438004:1.female: Tell me, what does the Great Will mean to you?

choice_prompt:5:1322438004.text: Tell me, what does the Great Will mean to you?
choice_prompt:5:1322438004.source_cn: 说说看，伟大意志在你心中是什么？
choice_prompt:5:1322438004.male: Tell me, what does the Great Will mean to you?
choice_prompt:5:1322438004.female: Tell me, what does the Great Will mean to you?

say:7:1322438008:1.text: Alright, alright, you pass. Next question... where does the Great Will come from?
say:7:1322438008:1.source_cn: ……算你过关。听好了，下一个问题是……伟大意志来自哪里？
say:7:1322438008:1.male: Alright, alright, you pass. Next question... where does the Great Will come from?
say:7:1322438008:1.female: Alright, alright, you pass. Next question... where does the Great Will come from?

choice_prompt:8:1322438008.text: Alright, alright, you pass. Next question... where does the Great Will come from?
choice_prompt:8:1322438008.source_cn: ……算你过关。听好了，下一个问题是……伟大意志来自哪里？
choice_prompt:8:1322438008.male: Alright, alright, you pass. Next question... where does the Great Will come from?
choice_prompt:8:1322438008.female: Alright, alright, you pass. Next question... where does the Great Will come from?

say:10:1322438012:1.text: Alright, alright. Go on in. Be devout!
say:10:1322438012:1.source_cn: 行了行了，进去吧进去吧。要虔诚！
say:10:1322438012:1.male: Alright, alright. Go on in. Be devout!
say:10:1322438012:1.female: Alright, alright. Go on in. Be devout!

say:12:1322438010:1.text: The Great Will only answers the prayers of the devout.
say:12:1322438010:1.source_cn: 伟大意志只会回应虔诚的心。
say:12:1322438010:1.male: The Great Will only answers the prayers of the devout.
say:12:1322438010:1.female: The Great Will only answers the prayers of the devout.

say:13:1322438011:1.text: Hmm, looks like one of us. But you can't go around spouting these words. The villagers might get suspicious.
say:13:1322438011:1.source_cn: 嗯，看来是自己人。不过你不能把这些词挂在嘴上，让镇民听...
say:13:1322438011:1.male: Hmm, looks like one of us. But you can't go around spouting these words. The villagers might get suspicious.
say:13:1322438011:1.female: Hmm, looks like one of us. But you can't go around spouting these words. The villagers might get suspicious.

choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 那要看你打算怎么忽悠镇民

say:14:1322438006:1.text: Yes! Follow the Great Will, and praise the true god!
say:14:1322438006:1.source_cn: 遵从伟大意志的指引，赞美伟大真神！
say:14:1322438006:1.male: Yes! Follow the Great Will, and praise the true god!
say:14:1322438006:1.female: Yes! Follow the Great Will, and praise the true god!

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 这不重要，赞美伟大意志就行了！

say:15:1322438007:1.text: Don't try to bluff me. I've seen your type before, and I'm not falling for it.
say:15:1322438007:1.source_cn: 不是普通信众？别跟我虚张声势，我不吃这一套！
say:15:1322438007:1.male: Don't try to bluff me. I've seen your type before, and I'm not falling for it.
say:15:1322438007:1.female: Don't try to bluff me. I've seen your type before, and I'm not falling for it.

choice_prompt:16:1322438007.text: Don't try to bluff me. I've seen your type before, and I'm not falling for it.
choice_prompt:16:1322438007.source_cn: 不是普通信众？别跟我虚张声势，我不吃这一套！
choice_prompt:16:1322438007.male: Don't try to bluff me. I've seen your type before, and I'm not falling for it.
choice_prompt:16:1322438007.female: Don't try to bluff me. I've seen your type before, and I'm not falling for it.

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 我是最实诚的、虔诚的、真诚的信众！

choice:5:2:3.text: Step aside. I'm no run-of-the-mill follower!
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 让开，我可不是普通的信众！
choice:5:2:3.male: Step aside. I'm no run-of-the-mill follower!
choice:5:2:3.female: Step aside. I'm no run-of-the-mill follower!

say:17:1322438003:1.text: Yeah, you. According to our rules, you've got to answer a couple questions before you get in.
say:17:1322438003:1.source_cn: 对的，就是你，按照规矩你要回答几个问题再进去。
say:17:1322438003:1.male: Yeah, you. According to our rules, you've got to answer a couple questions before you get in.
say:17:1322438003:1.female: Yeah, you. According to our rules, you've got to answer a couple questions before you get in.

say:1:1322442001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this ritual is a big deal for the cultists. A lot of high-ranking members will be there.
say:1:1322442001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this ritual is a big deal for the cultists. A lot of high-ranking members will be there.
say:1:1322442001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this ritual is a big deal for the cultists. A lot of high-ranking members will be there.

say:2:1322442002:1.text: Hey, that was supposed to be Chippy's line! Chippy got the intel!
say:2:1322442002:1.source_cn: 啊！你抢先说了！明明是满满打探到的！

say:3:1322442003:1.text: Sorry, didn't mean to steal your thunder. Go ahead.
say:3:1322442003:1.source_cn: 呃……对不起，要不你再说一遍？

say:5:1322442005:1.text: Magister, I think I just saw Irina.
say:5:1322442005:1.source_cn: 主人，我刚才好像看到了伊琳娜。
say:5:1322442005:1.male: Magister, I think I just saw Irina.
say:5:1322442005:1.female: Magister, I think I just saw Irina.

choice_prompt:6:1322442005.text: Magister, I think I just saw Irina.
choice_prompt:6:1322442005.source_cn: 主人，我刚才好像看到了伊琳娜。
choice_prompt:6:1322442005.male: Magister, I think I just saw Irina.
choice_prompt:6:1322442005.female: Magister, I think I just saw Irina.

say:7:1322442006:1.text: But Lev's not here... What are these cultists planning with her?
say:7:1322442006:1.source_cn: 可列夫并不在这里……这些邪教徒想利用她干什么呢？

choice_prompt:8:1322442006.text: But Lev's not here... What are these cultists planning with her?
choice_prompt:8:1322442006.source_cn: 可列夫并不在这里……这些邪教徒想利用她干什么呢？

say:9:1322442008:1.text: She's just a kid, too easy to manipulate. We should talk to her before it's too late.
say:9:1322442008:1.source_cn: 我觉得我们要找伊琳娜聊聊，她还那么小，太容易被邪教徒蛊...

say:10:1322442009:1.text: Rodrigo probably knows where she lives.
say:10:1322442009:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈肯定清楚她家的位置。

choice:8:0:1.text: Can't let her go to the ritual.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 无论如何都要阻止她参加祭祀
choice:8:0:1.male: Can't let her go to the ritual.
choice:8:0:1.female: Can't let her go to the ritual.

say:12:1322442007:1.text: These cultists are up to something shady! I'm sure of it!
say:12:1322442007:1.source_cn: 不用想都知道，这帮邪教徒一定有什么阴谋！

choice_prompt:13:1322442007.text: These cultists are up to something shady! I'm sure of it!
choice_prompt:13:1322442007.source_cn: 不用想都知道，这帮邪教徒一定有什么阴谋！

choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 我们得阻止她参加祭祀

choice:6:1:2.text: They want her at the ritual.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 邪教徒想让她参加祭祀
choice:6:1:2.male: They want her at the ritual.
choice:6:1:2.female: They want her at the ritual.

say:1:1322443001:1.text: First the gathering... now the ritual... these cultists are getting bolder by the day!
say:1:1322443001:1.source_cn: 礼拜……祭祀……这些邪教徒真是越来越猖狂了！

say:2:1322443002:1.text: And this time, a lot of the high-ups in the cult are showing up too.
say:2:1322443002:1.source_cn: 不仅如此，这次祭祀很多邪教徒的高层也会参加。

say:3:1322443003:1.text: It's the perfect opportunity to catch them all at once. I won't let a single one of them get away!
say:3:1322443003:1.source_cn: 这是将他们一网打尽的好机会。这回我一定不会放过它们！

say:4:1322443004:1.text: By the way, Sir Rodrigo, do you know where Irina lives?
say:4:1322443004:1.source_cn: 对了，罗德里戈先生，你清楚伊琳娜的家在哪吗？

say:5:1322443005:1.text: We saw her at the gathering earlier, and we're worried for her safety. We need to check on her.
say:5:1322443005:1.source_cn: 我们在刚才的礼拜中看到了伊琳娜，很担心她的情况，想要去...

say:6:1322443006:1.text: That's kind of you. Her house is <style="stress">south of Cedartown</style>, a <style="stress">standalone house</style>. You can't miss it.
say:6:1322443006:1.source_cn: 让你们费心了。她家在<style=stress>雪松镇...

say:0:1322444001:0.text: That drunk... must be Irina's father, right?
say:0:1322444001:0.source_cn: 那个醉鬼……应该是伊琳娜的父亲吧？

say:1:1322445001:1.text: Who the hell... are you? G-Get lost!

say:2:1322445002:1.text: We need to talk to Irina. It's important!
say:2:1322445002:1.source_cn: 我们找伊琳娜，有重要的事要和她说！

say:3:1322445003:1.text: O-Outta my way. I'm heading o-out for a drink.
say:3:1322445003:1.source_cn: 别……挡路，我正要出门、出门喝一杯。

say:5:1322445005:1.text: Tch. Who the hell are you...? Why do you... keep swaying around?
say:5:1322445005:1.source_cn: 啧，你们是谁啊……怎么……一个劲在、在晃？

say:6:1322445006:1.text: We're not swaying! You've had too much to drink!
say:6:1322445006:1.source_cn: 我们哪有晃啊！是你喝太多了吧！

say:7:1322445007:1.text: Too much? Pah... not nearly enough!
say:7:1322445007:1.source_cn: 喝太多？哪有……不够，根本不够！

choice_prompt:8:1322445007.text: Too much? Pah... not nearly enough!
choice_prompt:8:1322445007.source_cn: 喝太多？哪有……不够，根本不够！

say:9:1322445008:1.text: That kid... hic! She's not seeing anyone. Forget it! Go away!
say:9:1322445008:1.source_cn: 那孩子，嗝！谁也不会见的，省省吧你！走开，快走开！

say:10:1322445011:1.text: Get lost! I've got drinking to do... haha, drinking!
say:10:1322445011:1.source_cn: 走开，走开！别耽误我喝酒……哈哈，喝酒！

choice_prompt:11:1322445011.text: Get lost! I've got drinking to do... haha, drinking!
choice_prompt:11:1322445011.source_cn: 走开，走开！别耽误我喝酒……哈哈，喝酒！

say:12:1322445012:1.text: Tch, so annoying! Fine, fine! I got it. Now move along! I've got... a drink waiting!
say:12:1322445012:1.source_cn: 嘁，真是麻烦！行了行了，我、我知道了。让让，我……要去...

say:13:1322445016:1.text: I'll tell her not to leave the house... hic! Will that be enough for you?
say:13:1322445016:1.source_cn: 让她不要……近期不要出门，嗝！这就行了吧？

say:14:1322445017:1.text: Now move along... Do whatever you need to do! Just don't bother me again...
say:14:1322445017:1.source_cn: 你们，该干什么就……干什么去吧！别来烦老子……

choice:11:0:1.text: Just make sure you tell her.
choice:11:0:1.male: Just make sure you tell her.
choice:11:0:1.female: Just make sure you tell her.

say:16:1322445013:1.text: What... what do you want from me?

say:17:1322445014:1.text: This is about Irina's safety. If you won't do it, we'll have to use force or resort to magic.
say:17:1322445014:1.source_cn: 事关伊琳娜的人身安全，如果你做不到，我们就只能动用物理...

say:18:1322445015:1.text: Ugh... fine, fine. I'll tell her... just leave me alone.
say:18:1322445015:1.source_cn: 呃……算、算你厉害……行了，我……知道了。

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 你要是不听，就别怪我们……

say:19:1322445009:1.text: Brainwashed? Nonsense! Hic! Why would anyone brainwash that... useless brain of hers?
say:19:1322445009:1.source_cn: 蛊惑……什么蛊惑？瞎说，她……嗝，她有什么值、值得蛊惑的。

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 邪教徒正在蛊惑伊琳娜

say:20:1322445010:1.text: W-What's it to you? I'm her father! Who the hell are you to tell me what to do with her?
say:20:1322445010:1.source_cn: 关……关你什么事！我是她老子，你……你算什么，管我的事儿？

say:1:1322440001:1.text: We've lived on this land our entire lives and have never known true happiness. Cold, hunger, and poverty have always been with us!
say:1:1322440001:1.source_cn: 我们生在这片土地上从来没有真正幸福过，寒冷，饥饿，贫穷...

say:2:1322440002:0.text: And when we suffer, where's Dura? Have you ever wondered, like I do, if she's ever cared at all? She's not our goddess!
say:2:1322440002:0.source_cn: 我们受苦的时候艾雅在哪里？你是否跟我一样怀疑过艾雅从未...

say:3:1322440003:1.text: Praise the true almighty god, the only one who can truly guide us!
say:3:1322440003:1.source_cn: 赞美伟大真神，只有伟大意志才会指引我们！

cinematic_dialogue:9:1322439002:.text: That's because you're just flesh and bone.

say:11:1322440005:1.text: Sir, we've caught a heretic. What should we do with her?
say:11:1322440005:1.source_cn: 引导者大人，我们抓到了一位异教徒，该如何处置？

say:12:1322440006:1.text: Quit calling them that. There's no such thing as a heretic. They're just lost, that's all.
say:12:1322440006:1.source_cn: 别这样说，根本不存在什么异教徒，他们只是短暂的迷失了方...

say:13:1322440007:1.text: Look at me, child. What do you need? What can I do for you?
say:13:1322440007:1.source_cn: 看着我，孩子，我能帮助你做些什么吗？

say:15:1322440009:1.text: Looking for someone? You better not be looking for trouble.
say:15:1322440009:1.source_cn: 你说什么？捉人？难道是来找事的？！

say:16:1322440010:1.text: Take it easy. She's just having trouble speaking.
say:16:1322440010:1.source_cn: 冷静，她只是口齿不清罢了。

say:18:1322440012:1.text: You're looking for Lev? Ha! You must be Irina, then!
say:18:1322440012:1.source_cn: 你的意思是，来找列夫的吗？哈！原来你就是伊琳娜是吗！

say:20:1322440014:1.text: Of course, I know him. Lev's a drifter. He used to be a minstrel. Got his leg injured out in the cold, and now he'll never walk properly again.
say:20:1322440014:1.source_cn: 当然孩子，当然。列夫是个流浪汉，对吗？他原本是个吟游诗...

say:21:1322440015:1.text: Poor guy... When I first met him, I thought he was looking to get his leg fixed. But then he said, without hesitation, that he wanted to help you with your speech.
say:21:1322440015:1.source_cn: 真是个可怜人……我第一次见到他，还一位他的愿望是治好自...

say:23:1322440017:1.text: What a selfless man. The true almighty god answered his prayer and took him to paradise!
say:23:1322440017:1.source_cn: 多么善良无私的人啊，伟大真神已经回应了列夫！将他带到了乐园！

say:26:1322440018:1.text: But father, her speech... it's still not healed...
say:26:1322440018:1.source_cn: 神父，但这女孩的口疾也没好不是吗……

say:28:1322440020:1.text: Oh, you lost souls... You stand here among miracles, and you don't even see them.
say:28:1322440020:1.source_cn: 迷途的人啊……你们身在神迹中，却不知神迹已经发生着。

say:29:1322440021:1.text: Have you thought about why she's here? She's been sent to us by the Great Will. Her speech will be healed in the ritual!
say:29:1322440021:1.source_cn: 你们有没有想过她为什么会出现这？这一切都是伟大意志的调...

say:34:1322440024:1.text: Now listen, child. As promised, I need to invite you to the ritual. Will you come?
say:34:1322440024:1.source_cn: 孩子，按照约定，我必须邀请你参加祭祀，你愿意来吗？

say:35:1322440025:1.text: I... I just want my best friend. I don't want any... ritual.
say:35:1322440025:1.source_cn: 我……要列夫哥哥，不要……祭祀。

say:36:1322440026:1.text: To heal you, your friend Lev passed his test and went to paradise. Do you really want all the suffering he went through to be in vain?
say:36:1322440026:1.source_cn: 孩子，为了能治好你的病，你的列夫哥哥已经完成了考验，前...

say:38:1322440028:1.text: Yes! It's a place with no cold, no poverty. A warm and bountiful land, a true paradise!
say:38:1322440028:1.source_cn: 是的！那是一个没有寒冷贫穷，一个温暖富饶的地方，是真正...

say:39:1322440029:1.text: All you have to do is believe in the Great Will, and you'll be guided there. You'll be chosen to live in paradise!
say:39:1322440029:1.source_cn: 只要虔诚地信仰伟大意志，得到伟大意志的引渡，你们都会成...

say:40:1322440030:1.text: And you, my dear Irina, will be reunited with your dear friend there!
say:40:1322440030:1.source_cn: 而你，我的孩子伊琳娜，你会与你的列夫哥哥在乐园团聚！

say:41:1322440031:1.text: Brothers and sisters, in just a few days, the foretold time will come! We'll be waiting in the Duskmire Forest to welcome all who truly believe!
say:41:1322440031:1.source_cn: 诸位信众，再过几天便是神的伟大时日！我们将在黑沼森林恭...

narration:43:13052415:0.text: As the cult leader preaches to the villagers, one of the cultists brings Irina to stand at his side.
narration:43:13052415:0.source_cn: 邪教首领向镇民们传教时，一位邪教徒将伊琳娜带到了他的旁边。
